final_draft.answer: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
final_draft.note: I used the approved answer for control A1.2 word for word. It is owned by security@harborlight.example and valid until 2027-11-17. It only covers production databases. If the customer is also asking about other systems, such as file storage or config, this answer doesn't cover those.

answer:1306a39c-1708-4d3d-9cfa-9b624e3e3: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
answer:13a4b4ad-1230-4106-88d7-70f38753a: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:fa6722cd-9937-463e-8afa-6e5233f10: We test our disaster recovery plan annually. The last test was in March 2026 and met the recovery time objective of four hours.
policy:b415adcc-f3ca-4fb7-8de7-bc3e4e94c: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:f81f9009-82bb-4c42-b088-961997816: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
